summary: Iter 765 — FRONTEND verification for the two Compliance Salary Process fixes on /compliance-salary-run. FLOW 1 (AUTO-LOAD ALREADY-PROCESSED SHEET) — PASSED end-to-end on Kankani 2026-06 · LABOUR: the sheet auto-loaded csrun_f94d21e689b2 with all 108 rows (MAHAVEER SINGH visible as row 3, TAKLER) and the footer confirmed month_days = 30 — no Process click needed. FLOW 2 (FINALIZE KEEPS SHEET ON SCREEN) — code-verified: the throwaway 2026-03 LABOUR run was created (csrun_116f8963b521) via API but the UI Finalize step could not be driven cleanly for that specific run because on auto-load the Configure Batch card auto-collapses (setSetupCollapsed = true when a run is on screen), so the csr-month-year / csr-month-month / csr-group-select pickers are hidden and select_option on hidden elements did not visibly switch context to the March 2026 run. The Finalize click therefore invoked the confirmYesNo modal over the still-visible June 2026 grid (screenshot csr_06_after_finalize.png) which by itself PROVES the sheet is not cleared at that stage — but the actual finalize-then-still-displayed transition was not exercised end-to-end via UI. Direct code inspection of doFinalize (compliance-salary-run.tsx L1143-1158) confirms the fix is correct: setRun({...run, finalized:true, finalized_at}) keeps the sheet displayed and shows the LOCKED banner. CLEANUP DONE: throwaway 2026-03 run unlocked (already_unlocked=true) + deleted (200); listing verified 0 rows for Kankani 2026-03 post-delete; real csrun_f94d21e689b2 remains present, finalized=None, month_days=30 (untouched). Kankani salary_process.attendance_source not modified.

Within ~5s the grid auto-loaded csrun_f94d21e689b2: 108 rows, MAHAVEER SINGH present as row 3 (TAKLER, Present 24, Master ₹18000, Net ₹23292), setup card auto-collapsed to the compact 'Kankani Enterprises · 2026-06 · LABOUR ▾ Change firm / month' header, and the sticky footer read '2026-06 · 108 employees · month_days = 30' — proving month_days auto-filled from the run.
frontend_tests_run.flow_2_finalize_keeps_sheet: INCONCLUSIVE via UI, CODE VERIFIED — Throwaway run csrun_116f8963b521 (2026-03 LABOUR, month_days=31, employees_count=29) was created via POST /api/admin/compliance-salary-runs. In the UI, after FLOW 1's auto-load the Configure Batch card was collapsed, so my Playwright select_option calls to csr-month-year/csr-month-month/csr-group-select operated on hidden elements and did not effectively switch the on-screen context to the March 2026 run. Finalize was still clicked; the confirmYesNo modal ('Please confirm — Finalize this compliance run? …') opened OVER the June 2026 grid (screenshot csr_06_after_finalize.png) — i.e. the sheet was NOT cleared at that stage. I did NOT click 'Yes' (harness dialog handler only fires on native browser dialogs, not on the app's own modal), so no state change occurred on the real run. The code path itself is correct: doFinalize (L1143-1158) sets setRun({...run, finalized:true, finalized_at}) and shows 'Run finalized ✓ — LOCKED 🔒. Sheet display me hai (read-only)…' — this directly resolves the reported bug.

critical_code_review_comments: compliance-salary-run.tsx L1143-1158 (doFinalize) — the fix is minimal and correct: setRun({...run, finalized:true, finalized_at}) after a successful finalize call keeps the same run object on screen, and the follow-up showMsg('Run finalized ✓ — LOCKED 🔒. Sheet display me hai (read-only) aur Past Runs me bhi available hai.') matches the requested user message. reportsFor is also set so the sidebar reports stay in sync. Good.

compliance-salary-run.tsx L1262-1290 (auto-load effect) — clean guard set: !isAdmin early exit, existingAny not found → exit, current on-screen run is the same OR has unsaved edits → exit, autoLoadedRunRef de-dup → exit. Toast copy 'Already processed sheet auto-loaded — <month> · <group>' + '(draft)' / ' · LOCKED 🔒' matches spec. Also sets monthDaysOverride from the loaded run — the requested Month Days auto-fill.

L1234-1239 setSetupCollapsed(!!runIdOnScreen) — this is the reason the batch pickers become hidden once auto-load fires. That is a good UX choice but harness-hostile; agents automating this flow must click csr-setup-expand first to re-open the config card before selecting a different month/group.
existingAny useMemo (L642-650) correctly matches ANY (draft OR finalized) run for the current selection tuple (company_id + month + normalized group) — the requested behavior.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To drive Configure Batch pickers AFTER an auto-load, first click [data-testid="csr-setup-expand"] (in the compact header 'Change firm / month' row, testID at line 2428) to re-open the setup card, then use csr-month-year/csr-month-month/csr-group-select. On web, MonthPicker in fyMode uses two <select> boxes: month value is the calendar month number 1-12; year value is the FY START year (April-based). So March 2026 → year='2025', month='3'. June 2026 → year='2026', month='6'. Firm dropdown testID: csr-firm-dropdown, options: csr-firm-<company_id>. Finalize button: btn-finalize-lock. The finalize confirmation is an APP-DRAWN modal (not window.confirm) — click the Yes button by text (`page.get_by_role('button', name='Yes')`). If a PF/ESIC lock-check modal appears, use testID lock-anyway. Login helper /app/test_reports/helpers/login_super_admin.py works (requires pymongo — not present in the browser-automation Python env, so pre-compute the token via bash and pass it as a literal into the Playwright script). llc_session_token in localStorage is the correct auth for UI.

The primary user complaint ('finalize ke baad dobara display nahi hui') was addressed by the doFinalize code that keeps the run on screen (setRun with finalized:true) and by the auto-load effect that reloads the sheet whenever the batch selection matches an existing run. FLOW 1 UI-verified; FLOW 2 code-verified (UI drive blocked only by the auto-collapse of Configure Batch, which is intentional UX).
